lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with approximately equal vertical and horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming distinct anchor nodes that are particularly prominent in the mid-flank section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a clear luminance gradient with highlights on the superior margin and shadows on the inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of high-luminance spots that decrease in diameter towards the distal and trailing edges.
